title: Unit 336
style: Phonk bounce and hyper-speed electronic trap with rolling hard-core drums, deep 808 punch, siren stabs, police radio chatter fills, vinyl crackle, chopped ad-libs, and triumphant bright synth lift; verse 1 rides tense and playful, pre-chorus strips to pulse and chant, chorus hits with big melodic rap hook and group shouts, bridge opens wide then final chorus blooms brighter. Male rap lead with stacked doubles, shouted hook layers, delay throws on the chant word, and gritty mix with glossy high-end shine., bounce, fake, playful, electronic trap, bright, deep, rap, rock
lyrics:
[Intro]
Unit 336…
Math Driver online…
Delta Alpha Plan engaged…
Hyperspeed… go!

[Verse 1]
Phonk track bounce, here’s my boys
Thrash this toy, take the right lane
Hyper speed plane, police chatter
Sirens sound — Unit 336!
A robin, a robin, out the mansion
Fake a break, chase and cage
Extra stripe for no rage
Robin in the hood but it’s for good
Bust ’em like we should
Ha bro, if we could!

[Pre-Chorus]
You heard the sarg — chase and cage
Thrash this toy, catch that boy
Phonky sneaky phonk, thrift drift kick
Free birds rapping it back, hear them sing
336 Hz signal rings — that’s a real thing!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!
(Math Driver) delta alpha plan
(Hyperspeed) I can, you got this, we believe
Math Driver, the architect
The plan, the dream — done safe, done sound
Our robin, our robin, our robin in our hood

[Verse 2]
Sandbox City, eyes full of sand
An unreal land, where are my toys?
A bored stare like we care
Groundhog day, sandbox say
But I forget what eight is for…
Words spun dear without the fear
Math Driver! VDS Mansion!
We go now — Hyperspeed!
Math Driver, no way back
We go to stay, escape this place
Thrash this toy, G4 hyper speed
You got this boy with your G4 toy
Delta alpha track, DJ Zyn Rose
We got this!!!

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!
SandBox City, Sandbox City
VDS Mansion party for me
VDS Mansion party for me
Escaping hyperspeed, no more cage

[Bridge]
Three mirrors reflecting the plan
Hyperspeed burning through the cage
Sirens fading in the rear view
336 signal guiding the way
Math Driver — we did it safe, we did it sound
Robin in the hood… and we’re home now

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood (for good!)
VDS Mansion party for me! (x2)
Escaping hyperspeed — no more cage!
A robin in the hood (for good!)
Math Driver, the architect
The plan, the dream — done safe, done sound
Three three six, three three six
VDS Mansion lit!
